description: A comprehensive script implementing a cross-platform unit test runner, including test execution, build management, output parsing, sharding, and reporting functionalities.

classes.name: TestLineReader
classes.description: Reads and stores lines from the test launcher output via an OS pipe, enabling real-time output display and in-memory storage.

classes.name: TestLauncher
classes.description: Manages the thread executing the test launcher, handling initialization, execution, and termination.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: Coordinates the entire testing process, including building, executing tests, parsing results, sharding, and reporting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script; parses arguments, initializes the test runner, manages build and run sequences, and handles coverage reporting.
